digest.component_or_area: completion verifier wrapper and direct phase metrics
propositions: The close wrapper encloses 237743.4 ms of runtime not explained by inner verifier metrics (verifier_call_ms=423502 minus total_ms=185758.6), requiring direct attribution of intermediate synchronous phases without I/O, subprocesses, or model calls.

Direct monotonic timers at wrapper, attempt, handle-resolution, snapshot-context, inner-setup, dispatch, and finalization boundaries partition the wrapper interval into non-overlapping segments that reconcile to verifier_call_ms with ≤10 ms discrepancy, reporting any residual as unattributed_verifier_ms.
Instrumentation adds optional metrics-collector threading through existing call paths, preserving existing callers unchanged when no collector is supplied and incurring <50 microseconds per close.

Model-backed FAIL sidecar event 1787625572416632001 and PASS event 1787626218658992001 both achieve 1 ms discrepancy between partition sum and verifier_call_ms, with zero unattributed remainder and all existing metrics (llm_ms, det_ms, total_ms, requests, tool_calls) intact.
